svg.title: Usually, the 13 jobs of a request run across 12 systems that your app talks to one by one. With Pixeltable, the same 13 jobs live in one app.py, with its videos table and the APIs the other jobs use. A handle sweeps between the two sides.
svg.text: 13 jobs across 12 systems, and the scripts that keep them in sync
13 jobs in one app.py, as tables, computed columns, indexes and routes
